successCriteria.description: Define ILeaveService interface in src/modules/leave/leave.service.interface.ts with exactly these 7 methods: createLeaveRequest(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>, approveLeave(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, rejectLeave(id: string, rejecterId: string, reason: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, cancelLeave(id: string, cancellerId: string, reason: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, getLeaveRequestById(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, getLeaveRequestsByEmployee(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, getLeaveRequestsByStatus(status: LeaveStatus): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>
Implement LeaveService class in src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts that implements ILeaveService and injects ILeaveRepository via constructor
Validate date ranges: startDate must be before endDate; throw a domain error if invalid
Enforce status transition rules: only PENDING requests can be approved or rejected; only APPROVED requests can be cancelled; throw domain errors for invalid transitions
Set timestamps and actor IDs on status transitions: approvedBy + approvedAt on approve, rejectedBy + rejectedAt + rejectionReason on reject, cancelledBy + cancelledAt + cancellationReason on cancel

Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.service.test.ts with mocked ILeaveRepository covering all service methods, happy paths, and error paths (invalid date range, invalid status transitions, not-found scenarios)

constraints: GP-001: All database access must go through ILeaveRepository — LeaveService must never access the database directly
GP-006: All async errors must be caught and handled — no unhandled promise rejections in the service
outOfScope: Controller and routes layer (Phase 4) — HTTP handling, Fastify request/reply, schema validation, and route registration
Cross-module integration with balance module (Phase 9) — balance deduction on approve and balance restoration on cancel are deferred
Audit record creation (GP-002) — the service layer in this phase does not yet wire audit logging; that is deferred to a later integration phase

ambiguities.description: Error types for domain validation failures are not specified. The intent says to "throw a domain error" for invalid date ranges and invalid status transitions, but does not specify which error class(es) to use (e.g., a custom DomainError, ValidationError, or something from src/shared/error.types.ts). The code-agent will need to either create a domain error class or use an existing one.
options: Use a generic Error with descriptive message
Create a new LeaveDomainError class in the leave module
Use an existing error type from src/shared/error.types.ts if available
Use a NotFoundError for missing entities and ValidationError for business rule violations
